items: JIGAWA STATE (PSI 9.2): Governor Namadi Appoints 2,020 Teachers and Partners GTBank for Student Mobility Bicycles
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 9.1): Governor Mutfwang Secures Security Support in Abuja, Distributes N1.5bn and Reopens Hotel
CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 9.0): Governor Otu Reinstates 3,000 LG Workers and Seals 10 Unapproved Private Schools
NIGER STATE (PSI 8.8): Governor Bago Partners Federal Ministry on Livestock and Secures 20,000 Abattoir Jobs
EKITI STATE (PSI 8.7): Governor Oyebanji Flags Off 15 Inter-State CNG Buses to Slash Passenger Fares by 50%
IMO STATE (PSI 8.6): Governor Uzodimma Swears In 20 Permanent Secretaries to Restructure Public Service
LAGOS STATE (PSI 8.5): Governor Sanwo-Olu Meets US Consul General; State Advances 132kV Power Transmission
DELTA STATE (PSI 8.4): Delta State Flags Off Electric Vehicles Training and Empowerment Programme in Asaba
ABIA STATE (PSI 8.3): Governor Otti Hosts Umu-Aba Connect, Outlines International Hotel Deals and Road Projects
ANAMBRA STATE (PSI 8.2): President Tinubu Commissions EFCC Zonal Directorate Headquarters in Awka
TARABA STATE (PSI 8.1): Governor Kefas Convenes Security Council Meeting to Address Crime and Illegal Mining
NASARAWA STATE (PSI 8.0): Governor Sule Attends North-Central Rally Meeting and Advances NSUK Medical College
KWARA STATE (PSI 7.9): Governor AbdulRazaq Announces N50,000 Support Grant for All NYSC Corps Members
EDO STATE (PSI 7.8): Edo State Hosts 11th NILDS National Legislative Quiz Competition for Students
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 7.7): Governor Fintiri Swears In 1,428 NYSC Corps Members and Reaffirms Camp Funding
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 7.5): Zamfara Partners Correctional Service to Empower Inmates with Vocational Skills and Grants
JIGAWA (PSI 9.2): Appointed 2,020 secondary school teachers (1,100 permanent, 920 J-Teach) and partnered GTBank to distribute 450 bicycles to rural students walking long distances.
PLATEAU (PSI 9.1): Briefed President Tinubu on security camera deployment, launched N1.5bn victim relief distribution, and soft-opened the restored 1938 Hill Station Hotel under PPP.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 9.0): Reinstated 3,000 local government workers to the state payroll following labor union talks and sealed 10 unapproved private schools across Calabar-South/Odukpani.
NIGER (PSI 8.8): Hosted Livestock Minister, advancing a 200-cattle daily supply deal with Abis Abattoir Abuja generating 20,000 jobs, and urged Lagos-Kano-Jibia rail reactivation.
EKITI (PSI 8.7): Flagged off 15 CNG buses on inter-state routes connecting Ekiti to Lagos, Ibadan, Onitsha, and Abuja to slash commuter passenger fares by 50 percent.
IMO (PSI 8.6): Swore in 20 newly appointed Permanent Secretaries into the Imo State Civil Service to strengthen administrative efficiency, professionalism, and accountability.
LAGOS (PSI 8.5): Received US Consul General Brandon Hudspeth under California Sister State deal, advanced 132kV Ajah-Eleko power line, and increased ANC4 return rate to 56%.
DELTA (PSI 8.4): Flagged off a two-day Electric Vehicles Training and Empowerment Programme in Asaba to equip youth with technical skills in EV maintenance and operations.
ABIA (PSI 8.3): Hosted Umu-Aba Connect in Umuahia, confirming Radisson Blu and Hilton hotel investments in Aba alongside October road flag-offs on Uratta/Old Express.
ANAMBRA (PSI 8.2): Joined President Tinubu, represented by House Speaker Tajudeen Abbas, to commission the new EFCC Zonal Directorate Headquarters serving Anambra and Imo States.
TARABA (PSI 8.1): Convened emergency State Security Council meeting in Jalingo to tackle rising crime, illicit drug consumption, unprovoked attacks, and artisanal mining threats.
NASARAWA (PSI 8.0): Attended North-Central rally meeting in Abuja fixing October 10 for Lafia rally, and met NSUK Governing Council on launching College of Medicine in 2026/2027.
KWARA (PSI 7.9): Announced an immediate N50,000 support grant for all Batch C Stream 1 NYSC corps members posted to Kwara State to cushion economic realities.
EDO (PSI 7.8): Hosted 11th NILDS National Quiz Competition on Legislature and Democracy in Benin City with Annunciation Catholic College emerging overall winner.
ADAMAWA (PSI 7.7): Swore in 1,428 Batch C Stream I NYSC corps members at Damare Camp, reaffirming state funding for feeding allowances and permanent camp construction.
ZAMFARA (PSI 7.5): Met Correctional Service Controller, committing government to train inmates in vocational skills and provide empowerment grants for post-release self-reliance.
